switch.switchingCost: function switchingCost(currentJob){const buyout=num('buyoutAmount'),gapDays=num('gapDays'),oneTime=num('oneTimeCost'),gapLoss=((currentJob.salary+currentJob.allowance)/30)*gapDays,leaveOffsetText=$('canOffsetLeave').value==='yes'?'Annual leave may help reduce physical working days, subject to employer approval.':'No annual leave offset assumed. switch.labelDecision: function labelDecision(netAnnualGain,monthlyGain,breakEven,scoreDiff){if(netAnnualGain>=8000&&scoreDiff>=8&&breakEven<=6)return{level:'good',label:'Strong Switch',title:'The new offer looks financially and overall stronger.',text:'The new offer appears to provide a meaningful annual gain after switching costs, with a stronger decision score. Still check role risk, probation and contract terms before accepting.'};if(netAnnualGain>=3000&&breakEven<=8&&scoreDiff>=-3)return{level:'good',label:'Worth Considering',title:'The new offer looks worth considering.',text:'The new offer appears to improve your annual value, but the final decision depends on stability, workload, probation and whether the bonus assumptions are realistic.'};if(netAnnualGain>0&&scoreDiff<-8)return{level:'warn',label:'Risky Switch',title:'The money improves, but the non-money score drops.',text:'The new offer may pay more, but your stability, work-life balance or time value assumptions are weaker. Consider negotiating or getting more clarity before switching.'};if(netAnnualGain<0)return{level:'bad',label:'Not Financially Better',title:'The new offer does not look financially better under these assumptions.',text:'After CPF, job-linked costs and switching costs, the new offer does not provide a positive annual gain. Non-money reasons may still matter, but the financial case is weak.'};if(monthlyGain<=0)return{level:'bad',label:'No Monthly Gain',title:'The new offer does not improve your monthly value.',text:'The monthly value difference is zero or negative. Check whether AWS, bonus, commute or work costs are offsetting the headline salary increase.'};return{level:'warn',label:'Not Enough Difference',title:'The difference is not large enough to be obvious.',text:'The new offer may be slightly better, but the improvement is modest after switching costs.
